RUTZRINGS.Title: Ring Presets

Menu.Name: Ring presets
Menu.Label: Open
Menu.Hint: Make your own token rings and pick the one this world uses.

RUTZRINGS.PendingNote: "{name}" is applied after the next reload.
RUTZRINGS.PickHint: Edit a preset or make a new one.

Field.Name: Name
Field.ThicknessHint: Sets the token size inside the ring.
Field.ShadowHint: Adds a soft shadow inside the bottom of the ring.
Field.TintHint: On: that part turns grey and takes the ring colour.
Field.BandHint: Where the ring colour applies (0 centre, 1 edge).

DeleteDlg.Title: Delete preset
DeleteDlg.Content: Delete "{name}"? Its files stay in the world folder.
DeleteDlg.InUse: It is in use, so this world goes back to Foundry's default ring.

Notify.GMOnly: Only a GM can do this.
Notify.Applied: New ring set for this world.

HideDlg.Title: Hide ring
HideDlg.Content: Hide "{name}" in this world only? Module files and other worlds are not affected.

ResetDlg.Title: Reset ring
ResetDlg.Content: Put "{name}" back to the original "{original}"? Files stay in the world folder.

Tokenizer.Vtta: Tokenizer: default frames (PC, hostile NPC, other NPC, tint frame)
Tokenizer.Tok2: Tokenizer 2: frame rules for {system} (friendly, neutral, hostile; this system's other rules are replaced)
Tokenizer.UndoNote: The same button puts the old values back.
